input.title: BuyHub — free UK retailer example
input.instructions:
BUYHUB — UK RETRO-GAME RETAILER PROFILES
Prepared by Token Junkie Labs · 13 October 2026

The free package contains Hidden Chest Gaming / RetroGear. The separate US$20 package contains five additional retailers, each with a published business contact, buying context, tailored opening and original sources. Each ZIP includes the complete HTML, editable CSV, Markdown, JSON and this guide.

Use profiles.html in a browser to read the complete profiles; profiles.csv can be edited in a spreadsheet. Keep PAL/import region, model, working/untested condition, original packaging and total delivered cost separate when discussing a trial. Agree actual purchase constraints with the retailer before searching. Their existing tools and interest are for the conversation to establish.

The profiles identify publicly evidenced business fit. Source review date:13 October 2026. Stock examples describe categories; they do not establish an active restocking request. Current BuyHub account limits and marketplace availability govern any trial.

One correction or replacement is included within seven days for an existing customer, duplicate, dead published contact or clear mismatch. Reply to the original Token Junkie Labs conversation with the affected company and reason.

Prepared by Token Junkie Labs.

customer_packages.title: BuyHub — free UK retailer example
customer_packages.instructions:
BUYHUB — UK RETRO-GAME RETAILER PROFILES
Prepared by Token Junkie Labs · 13 October 2026

The free package contains Hidden Chest Gaming / RetroGear. The separate US$20 package contains five additional retailers, each with a published business contact, buying context, tailored opening and original sources. Each ZIP includes the complete HTML, editable CSV, Markdown, JSON and this guide.

Use profiles.html in a browser to read the complete profiles; profiles.csv can be edited in a spreadsheet. Keep PAL/import region, model, working/untested condition, original packaging and total delivered cost separate when discussing a trial. Agree actual purchase constraints with the retailer before searching. Their existing tools and interest are for the conversation to establish.

The profiles identify publicly evidenced business fit. Source review date:13 October 2026. Stock examples describe categories; they do not establish an active restocking request. Current BuyHub account limits and marketplace availability govern any trial.

One correction or replacement is included within seven days for an existing customer, duplicate, dead published contact or clear mismatch. Reply to the original Token Junkie Labs conversation with the affected company and reason.

Prepared by Token Junkie Labs.
